name: Order of the Chariot
body:
Edicts

The charioteer spreads fear across the battlefield, cowing the weak among his enemies in order to separate them from the worthy adversaries. He must engage the worthy without fear and strive to impose the will of his sovereign upon the world.

Challenge: Whenever an order of the charioteer issues a challenge, he receives a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls against the target of his challenge so long as he is driving his chariot. The bonus increases by +1 for every four levels the cavalier possesses.
Skills: Knowledge (engineering). When the charioteer uses Knowledge (engineering) or Craft (carpentry) to repair his chariot, he gains a bonus on the check equal to 1/2 his cavalier level (minimum +1).

Order Abilities: A cavalier belonging to the Order of the Chariot gains the following abilities as he increases in level.

Shocking Turn

At 2nd level, while performing a ride-by attack with his chariot, a charioteer may forego his attack in order to demoralize opponents. He makes an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes he threatens during the drive-by movement.

Slashing Turn

At 8th level, while performing a ride-by attack with a chariot, a charioteer can slash opponents with the chariot’s bladed axle caps. He may expend attacks of opportunity to attack additional targets he threatens during the ride-by movement. These additional attacks are made by the bladed axle cap of your chariot, and at the charioteers highest  BAB. The blades do 2d3 +1 per 2 cavalier levels slashing damage. The charioteer may perform slashing turn a number of times per day equal to his Charisma modifier. Opponents may avoid these attacks by going prone.

Battlefield Menace

At 15th level, the charioteer inspires his allies with his daring battle tactics. While performing a drive-by attack, the charioteer, as a swift action, shouts a battle cry. This grants the cavalier and his allies a +4 bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws and skill checks for the duration of battlefield menace. The cavalier can end this ability as a swift action. He can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to half his cavalier level.
